known_limitations: The revision clock started 2026-08-20T16:40:21.746594Z but the load window in this manifest starts 21:50Z. Per FD-WAVE3-1 the driver's refresh_token was only called from inside the request loop, gated on a timer pre-seeded to start_ts, so the token file was never created within a 25-minute run and every request carried an empty bearer for the first 5h10m. Fixed and verified (41/41 at HTTP 200 immediately after), and the window was extended so this manifest counts 12h of LOADED soak rather than the empty head.

Loaded coverage is 58.1%, not 100%. The load agent's launchd StartInterval schedules from job EXIT rather than start, so a 25-minute run on a 1800s interval produced ~55-minute cycles until the interval was corrected to 300s at 04:32Z. Per-cycle successful requests rose from ~700 to ~925 after that correction.
Trigger C (fee ceiling) is not exercisable on demand and was NOT simulated. It remains un-exercised for this train.
Simultaneous two-org org-queue runs remain un-exercised.
